title: Design System: Kanban V1 Work Plot

display.purpose: Masthead board title; italic serif at 1.5rem/600.

title.purpose: Card titles at 0.9375rem; sheet and dialog titles step up to 1.25rem/1.125rem.

body.purpose: Controls, notes, banners; system UI at 0.875rem/1.45.

label.purpose: Uppercase letterspaced field labels, block titles, lane headings, card meta.

data.purpose: Mono ids, codes, and tabular figures (counts, positions, progress).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions, sheet-in, and control hovers.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button, tick, card, and ruling-layer state changes.

breakpoints.name: masthead-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Masthead top grid stacks to one column; progress readout wraps.

breakpoints.name: board-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Lane scale hides for step buttons, 78vw lanes with scroll snap, full-width sheet, two-column status strip, 2.75rem targets.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default stamped chart-print control; hover fills chart blue deep.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--s1); min-height: 2.25rem; padding: var(--s2) var(--s3); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--blue-deep); border-color: var(--blue-deep); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled affirmative action (Apply, New card, Create card, Retry).
components.css: .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn--primary:hover { background: var(--blue-deep); border-color: var(--blue-deep); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn--primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary control (Clear, Graticule, Refresh) with softened border and text.
components.css: .ds-btn--quiet { border-color: var(--rule-strong); color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-btn--quiet:hover { background: var(--blue-deep); border-color: var(--blue-deep); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn--quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action in the single correction magenta.
components.css: .ds-btn--danger { border-color: var(--magenta); color: var(--magenta); } .ds-btn--danger:hover { background: var(--magenta); border-color: var(--magenta); color: var(--paper); } .ds-btn--danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Uppercase label over a hard-edged select or input on paper.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--s1); } .ds-field__label { font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-field__control { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: var(--s1) var(--s2); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-field__control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: Plotted ticket: italic serif title, uppercase meta, mono id.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: var(--s2) var(--s3); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms var(--ease-out), background-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-deep); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card__title { display: block; font-family: var(--font-title); font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card__meta { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--s2); margin-top: var(--s1); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-card__id { font-family: var(--font-data); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }

components.name: Lane Header with Lamp
components.description: Sticky lane strip: printed state lamp, uppercase heading, tabular count. Hazard variant shown.
components.css: .ds-lane-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--s2); padding: var(--s3) var(--s3) var(--s2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); } .ds-lane-head__title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-lane-head__count { margin-left: auto; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-lamp { align-self: center; width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink-soft); position: relative; flex: none; } .ds-lamp--hazard { border-color: var(--magenta); background: var(--magenta); }

components.name: Plot Tick
components.description: One step of the numbered 1-9 lane scale; in-view ticks wash sea.
components.html: <button class="ds-tick" type="button" data-inview="true" aria-label="Show lane 4 of 9: REVIEW">4</button>
components.css: .ds-tick { position: relative; min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out), color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-tick:hover { border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--ink); } .ds-tick[data-inview="true"] { background: var(--sea); color: var(--ink); } .ds-tick:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Stamp
components.description: Tiny bordered provenance mark for labeled synthetic data.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 0 var(--s1); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); }

narrative.overview: Kanban V1's board is drawn as a chart-room plotting table: cards sit as plotted labels inside nine ruled status lanes, dependencies are course lines drawn between them, and every quiet surface is a printed sheet of chart paper. The visual system is chart-print: a chart-white ground, ink black text, chart-blue graticule hairlines and interactive strokes, and a single magenta correction color for attention states. There are no rounded corners, no shadows, and no decorative imagery; structure is carried by hairlines, printed state marks, and tabular figures. The global system is the durable layer documented here: palette roles, type voices, rule geometry, flat depth, and the control vocabulary (buttons, fields, cards, lamps, stamps). The board's passage-plan composition (nine lanes as a plotted route, live dependency course lines, the toggleable graticule state, the title-block masthead) is the board surface concept owned by .impeccable/surfaces/static-index-html.md, not a global mandate. Other surfaces reuse the chart-print language without being forced into the lane/course-line layout.
keyCharacteristics: Flat chart-print surfaces: 1px hairline rules, zero radius, no shadows, no gradients except the graticule ruling.
Two-voice typography: italic serif titles against upright system UI and mono tabular data; no fetched webfonts.
One correction accent: magenta only for attention/blocked/rejected states; chart blue is the interactive voice, green the done state.
Printed state vocabulary: square lamps with inset marks, ink fills for pressed/current controls, 2px ink outlines for focus and selection.
Graticule as a real user state (toggle), not texture.
Keyboard-first: every state change is visible and focus is always drawn.

rules.name: The One Correction Rule
rules.body: Magenta appears only where the plan needs correction or attention (blocked, rejected, error, destructive). It is never a styling accent; its rarity is what makes a blocked move read instantly.

rules.name: The Graticule State Rule
rules.body: The chart-blue ruling (--sea-line) is the chart world made operable: the Graticule control toggles it (#grid-toggle, aria-pressed, static/app.js:1226-1231), so it carries state rather than acting as decoration. This is approved direction (surface brief OWN-WORLD chart-blue graticule hairlines; FORM toggleable graticule as a real state), and the design detector's repeating-stripes-gradient advisory is accepted for exactly this reason: the brief wins.

rules.name: The Chart-White Ground Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never darken to signal hierarchy; tonal steps (sea, deep paper) mean state (in-view, hover, pressed, loading), not elevation.

rules.name: The No-Webfont Rule
rules.body: Nothing is fetched at runtime: no font files, no external assets. Identity must survive offline, so structure, rules, case, and tabular figures carry the chart character.

rules.name: The Italic-Means-Voice Rule
rules.body: Italic is for titles and quiet empty-state notes, never for controls, labels, or data.

rules.name: The Flat Chart Rule
rules.body: No shadow, no glow, no blur. A surface that needs attention takes a border, a rule, or a state mark, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Right-Angle Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded. State lives in borders, fills, rule weight, and mark geometry, not corner smoothing.

dos: Do keep `border-radius` at 0 and carry structure with 1px rules; the system has no `box-shadow`.
Do keep magenta to correction and attention contexts; chart blue is interactive, green is done, neutrals are everything else.
Do use tabular numerals for every count, id, and position.
Do keep the graticule a user-toggled state in chart blue; it is approved direction, not a pattern violation.
Do draw focus with the shared 2px ink outline at 2px offset and keep hover in the chart-blue-deep fill family.
Do treat the surface brief's lane/course-line composition as board-local: it can change without touching this file, while the palette, type voices, rules, and state marks are the durable contract.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and `forced-colors`; both already have global rules (`static/app.css:1204-1237`).
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients (beyond the graticule ruling), glows, or rounded corners.
Don't fetch webfonts or any external asset; the board stays fully offline (asserted in `tests/static.test.mjs`).
Don't introduce a second attention color or reuse magenta decoratively.
Don't rely on color alone for status; lamp geometry, counts, and text labels accompany every state.
Don't promote the nine-lane passage-plan concept into the global system; it belongs to the board surface.
